name_zh: 维诺格拉多夫三素数定理
source_claim_verbatim_translation: Every sufficiently large odd integer can be represented as a sum of three primes.
canonical_claim: There exists a threshold N such that every odd natural number n at least N is equal to p + q + r for some primes p, q, and r; repetition is provisionally permitted pending pinpoint source review.
domain_and_universes: Provisional natural numbers for the threshold, represented odd number, and three prime summands; conclusion in Prop; no nontrivial universes expected. An integer-domain source presentation requires a checked transport.
ordered_binders_provisional: if N <= n and n is odd
there exist p q r : Nat with each prime
hypotheses_requiring_statement_freeze: the exact meaning and quantifier order of sufficiently large
whether repeated prime summands are allowed
whether prime means positive natural prime and whether any ordering of summands is imposed
whether the source states only existence or also an asymptotic representation count
conclusion: Every odd input beyond one uniform threshold has a representation as the sum of three primes.

alternate_encodings.target: Filter.Eventually (fun n : Nat => n % 2 = 1 -> exists prime p q r, n = p + q + r) Filter.atTop
an integer-domain formulation with positive prime summands

excluded_degenerate_cases: Even inputs, inputs below the eventual threshold, zero or one as a prime, distinctness of summands, ordered triples, and replacement of existence by an asymptotic counting formula must be treated explicitly rather than inferred.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical and choice dependencies of the eventual analytic proof remain to be frozen and audited
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib; exact minimal import and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No finite prime search, numerical cutoff, oracle, native computation, or external computation is credited at intake
formal_system: Lean 4 + mathlib under the rev-5.6 adapter
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the selected source, eventual quantifiers, domain or prime conventions, Lean target, imports/toolchain, dependency pin, trust policy, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: Self-tested planned intake only. No exact Lean expression, statement fingerprint, H0, M0, R0, accepted proof state, audit completion, master acceptance, or theorem completion is claimed.
